labels.definition: sign of NIFTY spot return over next 30 minutes; zero/flat treatment fixed in label manifest
sign of next-session close-to-close NIFTY spot return; zero/flat treatment fixed in label manifest

common_rules.decision_time: timestamp of the forecast row; features must be available by that time
common_rules.flat_return: exclude flat returns from directional two-class labels; separately report exclusion count; no threshold tuned on evaluation data
common_rules.intraday_sessions: only labels fully contained within a trading session; no overnight carry
common_rules.positional_sessions: next session close-to-close; no overlap with intraday label rows in same metric family
common_rules.purge_embargo: purge overlapping label windows and apply embargo at fold boundaries
common_rules.minimums: exact sample count, missingness, and class-support thresholds must be frozen and tester-approved before empirical run
